module.name: axm-invariant-lab
module.purpose: Bounded state-space exploration, cross-implementation checking, tractability measurement, read-only donor refinement evidence, and explicit external-consumer contract continuity for modeled AXM invariants.

capabilities.description: Explore a finite, explicitly declared transition model breadth-first to find shortest invariant counterexamples or preserve unknown observations as HOLD.

evidence.boundary: second implementation shares the authored model transition and invariant functions; model fidelity is not independently proven

capabilities.description: Cross-check the primary visited-state explorer with an independent bounded path enumerator and fail closed when the reference enumeration budget is incomplete.
Measure deterministic work-count boundaries between the visited-state explorer and independent all-path verifier on a bounded reconverging fixture, preserving budget exhaustion as HOLD.

evidence.boundary: synthetic reconverging model only; no wall-clock, arbitrary-model, solver, donor-runtime, or real-world performance claim

capabilities.description: Read-only refinement of AXM Monolith Pipeline Fabric v0.1 candidate-only and explicit no-automatic-authority fields against a pinned donor contract fixture.

evidence.boundary: separately authored adapter over an exact pinned donor contract fixture; no full-stack Monolith runtime export is claimed

capabilities.description: Emit bounded machine-readable FAIL/HOLD evidence without granting donor, execution, merge, promotion, or CANON authority.

evidence.boundary: AXM Monolith consumes the exact v0.1 packet as evidence-only; a second materially different external AXM consumer is still required for seed rung 6

capabilities.description: Track exact producer packet/schema blobs pinned by external AXM consumers and fail closed when local producer bytes drift until compatibility is deliberately reviewed.

evidence.boundary: local compatibility guard attests producer byte identity only; it does not remotely execute or attest the external consumer runtime

truth_boundary: A PASS means no counterexample was found only inside the exact declared model, predicates, transitions, bound, or explicit donor fields actually inspected. Cross-implementation agreement checks exploration semantics over shared authored model functions; tractability evidence is a deterministic synthetic work-count boundary, not a general performance claim; pinned donor refinement does not prove a full donor runtime. One real external Monolith consumer now uses the counterexample packet without semantic promotion, but seed rung 6 remains unearned until a second materially different external AXM consumer exists. External-consumer continuity checks only producer byte identity. This module grants no execution, merge, promotion, installation, device, network, or CANON authority.
